<title level="1" right="Focus 1" pfs="Standard">
[Patron's Puppet](/Spells.aspx?ID=1882)
<actions string="Free Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Focus" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=511" />
<trait label="Hex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=324" />
<trait label="Witch" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=734" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 385

<row gap="medium">

 

**Trigger** Your turn begins

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

At your unspoken plea, your patron temporarily assumes control over your familiar. You Command your familiar, allowing it to take its normal actions this turn. Your Command does not have the [auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16) or [concentrate](/Actions.aspx?ID=683) traits; your patron simply moves its agent directly.
name: Patron's Puppet
